mechanism: Rizatriptan is a 5-HT1B/1D agonist and lisdexamfetamine increases serotonergic activity; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome, and amphetamines may potentiate vasoconstrictive effects of triptans increasing cardiovascular risk.
action: Use combination cautiously; monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia) and cardiovascular events; consider alternative migraine therapy if possible.
